source_ref: Muller CA, Riemer S, Viranyi Z, Huber L, Range F (2016) PLOS ONE 11(2):e0147753, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0147753. Mapping: S3 File (supplementary s007, .xlsx) sheet 'Description of Variables', rows 4-6. Item text: main article, Methods > 'Inhibition tasks'. Option text: S2 Table (supplementary s015, PDF).
note: INSTRUMENT MISMATCH (Step 3b): the IRW dictionary Description reads 'Inhibitory-control (cylinder) task, pet dogs, 3 trials, 0-2 ordinal, N=41'. The word 'cylinder' appears nowhere in Muller et al. (2016) and there is no cylinder task in the study. Inhibition1/2/3 are not three trials of one task: they are three DISTINCT inhibitory-control tasks, identified by the S3 File's own 'Description of Variables' sheet as Inhibition1='Score of wait-for-treat task', Inhibition2='Score of middle cup task', Inhibition3='Score of leash task'. Item text was extracted against what the data actually is; the dictionary Description should be corrected. Consequence for analysts: the three items are NOT exchangeable replications, so a single-trait model over them assumes more than the design supports (the paper itself reports performance is only weakly correlated across its three inhibition tasks). OPTION TEXT: verbatim from S2 Table (s015, 'Scoring of inhibitory control tasks in videos of final sessions'); the score-1 middle-cup criterion is transcribed with the source's own typo 'but with a least one success' (sic, for 'at least'). SECTION_PROMPT carries S2 Table's per-task footnote definitions of success/mistake/failure, which are task-specific, hence one section_id per item. ITEM_TEXT is the paper's own verbatim task-definition sentences from the 'Inhibition tasks' Methods subsection; there is no participant-facing item wording because the subjects are dogs and each item is an experimenter-scored behavioural task. MISSINGNESS is by design, not a defect: 41 dogs x 3 tasks = 123 cells, live table has 115 rows (Inhibition1 n=39, Inhibition2 n=40, Inhibition3 n=36); the paper states 8 dogs completed only two of the three tasks, and 123-115=8 exactly. The derived 'InhibitionScore' column was deliberately not shipped by data/muller_2016_dog_inhibition.py. RIGHTS: tasks are the authors' own (middle cup adapted from their ref [56]); paper and supplements are CC BY 4.0; no reserved right found, no block.
public_note: The three items are three different inhibitory-control tasks (wait-for-treat, middle cup, leash), not three trials of one task, so the 0-2 scores are not exchangeable replications; the IRW dictionary Description calling this a 'cylinder task, 3 trials' is incorrect.
